method_notes.purpose: Benchmark image-native features extracted directly from MRI+mask against radiomics/scanner tables and their fusion.
method_notes.image_feature_definition: Intensity, histogram, gradient, geometry, spacing, and central-slice embedding statistics extracted from tumor-masked MRI volumes.
method_notes.selection_policy: All preprocessing and selection are fit on TRAIN only inside sklearn Pipelines. Model family and threshold are chosen on VALID only. TEST remains locked for final evaluation.
